<script>
        $wire.hook('morphed', function () {
            if ($wire.product) {
                document.body.classList.add('overflow-y-hidden');
                window.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKeyOnProductDetail);
            } else {
                document.body.classList.remove('overflow-y-hidden');
                window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKeyOnProductDetail);
            }
        });

        function handleEscapeKeyOnProductDetail(event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' || event.key === 'Backspace') {
                $wire.clearProductId();
            }
        }
    </script>
